messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2025-02-13] standup/boreal/2025-02-13: The notifier calls the event-bus for delivery events, so treat the event-bus as a hard dependency of the notifier. Dependency map update: webhooks needs the event-bus (outbound events).
- [2026-02-24] standup/dune/2026-02-24: Reminder from team Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2026-06-03] standup/dune/2026-06-03: Reminder from team Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-03-25] handover/2026-03-25-billing-api: The billing API has a new home: team Dune. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-03-13] standup/boreal/2026-03-13: Deploy freeze for the ledger: 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 (the fiscal year close).
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2026-01-02] standup/boreal/2026-01-02: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-03-06] incident-review/INC-2025-004: INC-2025-004 review. What happened: notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04. Why: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Follow-up decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2026-03-09] standup/dune/2026-03-09: Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-18] standup/boreal/2026-03-18: Reminder that the product catalog depends on the resizer.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31-2: We agreed today that the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. The reason is that the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-02-11] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2: Reminder: the event-bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-20] standup/dune/2026-03-20: Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-17] standup/cinder/2025-02-17: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-10-02] standup/cinder/2025-10-02: On-call rotation: Yuki is primary for team Cinder starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-02-28] handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer: Quick one: the indexer belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to Cinder for running it until now.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
